decision_skill.name: override_persistence_on_regime_shift
decision_skill.description: Replace a persistence-based forecast assumption when verified evidence identifies a durable structural change in the target-generating process and quantifies its subsequent effect.
decision_skill.applicability: When a forecast horizon contains a documented intervention, competitive change, policy shift, operational change, or similar regime break with reliable post-change observations.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Prefer the evidence-adjusted candidate whose observation window best represents the stable post-change regime; override the host default only when the change is causally relevant, temporally aligned, explicitly quantified, and assessed as persistent rather than transient.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when the evidence is unverified, outside the permitted temporal window, merely correlational without a plausible mechanism, based on an unstable transition period, or insufficient to distinguish a permanent level shift from temporary noise.
